answer: An attester must stake 19% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the opal stake is held until the willow settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the lagoon audit lists each exposure. A farm running 74 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
